main_text.p: scelera perpetrata. Dicitur autem Erynnis, ut quidam volunt, ἀπὸ τῆς ἐεἰδ[?] ἢ νοῦ, quasi lis & contentio animi, cujus meminit poëta 2. Æneid. Mirabile hic in conscientia aliquid adnotes, quòd sit judex, actor, reus, scriba unus & idem in hoc foro.
main_text.head: Cap. 8. De prudentia.
main_text.p: PRudentia est habitus practicus, quo quisPrudentia, inclinatur ad assentiendum conclusionibus practicis.
main_text.head: Ejus theoremata sunt.
main_text.p: I. Prudentis est applicare, seu determinare, sapientis explicare. Methodum philosophi faciunt duplicem, sapientiæ & prudentiæ, exquisitam & popularem.Methodus est duplex. Methodus sapientiæ est, quæ naturam rei scrutatur, & τὰ γνωσιμώτερα φύσει observat. Methodus prudentiæ est, quæ ordinem meliorīs doctrinæ observat, & τὰ γνωσιμώτερα ἡμῖν præmittit.

II. Licet prudentia etiam externos actus regat, circa internos tamen, unde externi manant, præcipuè versatur. Itaq; externum bonum opus non tam virtus est, quàm virtutis declaratio, & malum opus non tam vitium, quàm vitii declaratio.
III. Prudentiæ disponuntur methodo a-nalytica: ut sapientiæ & scientiæ synthetica.
Proinde in prudentiis tria confideran-tur: finis, subjectum, & media.

page.notes: The Greek words in the first paragraph and in the thesis "I." are doubtful: "ἐεἰδ[?]" and "ἢ νοῦ" are not fully legible at this scan resolution. The ornamental border line between the opening paragraph and the chapter heading is decoration and was omitted. The marginal note "Methodus / est duplex." is printed in two lines in the margin and is transcribed as one note. The "V 2" signature is at the foot of the page.
